mechanism.base: Your core is Metal, and here Metal stands with Metal: edge alongside edge, the same ore twice refined. This is a reinforcement rather than a reaction, the part of your chart that is simply more of you. That is why Metal is your Body: the strength you stand on, your stance, your word made physical. Where the other energies act on you, this one just holds the line.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the line wavers: opinions borrowed, standards negotiable, an edge that answers to whoever held it last. Your chart asks you to feed the self. Practice your craft alone until it rings.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the edge seals itself in: so much certainty that nothing else gets past it. Honor the standard, and let one trusted voice through.

function.definition_catalyst:
Metal is your Body, and running thin, it is the reserve everything else draws on: sleep, food, recovery, the physical base under your discipline. Yours holds form long after the fuel is low, so you notice depletion late.

Day to day this looks like powering through on standards instead of strength, colds that arrive the moment a push ends, and pride in needing less than other people. The crash always comes after the deadline, never before it.

The program: put maintenance on the calendar before you need it, a fixed bedtime, real meals, one full rest day a week. Track energy like money for a month. Treat the first sign of wear as the warning, never as the baseline.
function.definition_friction:
Metal is your Body, and running over, it is more physical force than your life currently spends: discipline with no outlet, stamina turning into tension you carry in your shoulders and jaw.

Day to day this looks like restlessness at rest, workouts that calm you more than vacations do, and a body that braces for effort even on quiet days. Unused strength shows up as irritation first, and sleep only fully arrives after real exertion.

The program: give it a hard weekly outlet, lifting, long walks, manual work, and watch the tension drop. Pair every sitting-heavy day with something physical. When your patience shortens, train before you talk.

dips.mind: Your judgment holds like your frame does: conclusions struck once and kept, worth re-testing on a schedule.
dips.action: Decisions become motion fast in you: once judged, a thing is already being done.

candidates.cta_verdict: You bend for nothing and call it strength, and your body keeps that bargain until the day it presents the bill.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Core is your endurance function: the seat where strength is stored and spent. With Metal doubled here, your constitution is tempered steel: slow to tire, slower to bend, holding shape under loads that fold softer frames. Your reserves run deep and cold, and you mistake that for endlessness. The craft is maintenance without occasion: oil the blade before it asks, and let rest keep your temper.
